reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes an online earning plan by presenting a claimed daily income of one lakh rupees and directing viewers to reply for a link and attend a meeting to become members. The speaker presents his own earnings as encouragement to join, while the repeated Forsage, Eagle Team and WhatsApp contact displays reinforce a direct recruitment call to action rather than reporting or analysis.

citations.quote: Every day there is one lakh Rupee
if you want to earn money online please reply this
ask for the link of a plan meeting attend a one meeting
you can become one of our members

opening.argument: The available statement is a first-person account, not a promise that every viewer will receive a particular return. The speaker describes what he says he sees and uses conditional language about others: “if I earn a lot of money from here then you can also.” Nothing in the supplied material states that viewers are guaranteed income, required to deposit funds, or asked to provide credentials. A cautious reading therefore supports treating this as an informal referral to investigate a service, with the actual plan left for a meeting rather than certified as risk-free.

citations.quote: if I talk about the income then its 1226 BSP
if i earn a lot of money from here then you can also
ask for the link of a plan meeting attend a one meeting

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution turns an earnings account and an invitation to learn more into a guarantee, but the cited words do not say that joining ensures income. “Every day there is one lakh Rupee” is presented as the speaker’s account, while the later wording is conditional. The meeting invitation can be read as a chance to inspect the plan before deciding, not proof of deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Every day there is one lakh Rupee
attending a meeting you will understand the plan

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The conditional phrasing does not neutralize the promotional message. The speaker pairs his claimed earnings with a direct request to reply, obtain a plan link, attend a meeting, and become a member. The record need not contain an express guarantee or deposit demand for this to be recruitment-centered promotion; those omissions do not explain away the concrete membership call to action.

citations.quote: if you want to earn money online please reply this
you can become one of our members

opening.argument: The presentation can reasonably be understood as an operational demonstration and personal walkthrough. The speaker discusses a displayed earnings figure and, in the sampled imagery, holds a phone toward the camera while the video visibly carries Forsage and WhatsApp markings. He directs interested viewers to a meeting where they can understand the plan, which is consistent with explaining how the service works before participation. The supplied material does not show the speaker analyzing a downline calculation, taking payment, or documenting a completed recruitment transaction.

citations.quote: here you can see 1226 BSP
by attending a meeting you will understand the plan

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a demonstration fits the visible phone presentation and the explicit invitation to attend a meeting to understand the plan. The prosecution’s interpretation relies on the promotional setting, but that setting does not establish that the video’s primary purpose is deceptive recruitment rather than showing the speaker’s use of an earning platform and explaining how viewers can learn more.

citations.quote: attend a one meeting and by attending a meeting you will understand the plan

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The phone and branding show presentation, not educational content. The speaker does not explain an operation, process, or principle; he highlights claimed earnings and tells viewers to reply for a link and become members. A meeting that explains the plan is also the proposed route into that membership, so the demonstration framing fails to address the recruitment purpose.

citations.quote: if you want to earn money online please reply this
you can become one of our members

opening.argument: At most, the material depicts a referral-style promotion for an online earning service. It names a platform in the title and asks interested people to request a link and learn about the plan. That is compatible with ordinary referral or membership promotion; the supplied evidence does not show a required deposit, a promised return for recruiting others, a request for financial credentials, or a demonstrated tiered calculation. The claimed amount is reported as the speaker’s own figure, while viewers are told they can attend a meeting and decide what the plan means.

citations.quote: Real Earning platform
ask for the link of a plan
attending a meeting you will understand the plan
you can become one of our members

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited contact and membership language establishes an invitation, but not the mechanism the prosecution asks the judge to infer. There is no supplied evidence of a deposit, credential request, or payment for recruiting a downline. A referral promotion can use a contact channel and membership invitation without thereby proving that the underlying service is a scam.

citations.quote: ask for the link of a plan meeting attend a one meeting

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing deposit or credential request is beside the point. The defining evidence is the combination of a named earning plan, claimed personal income, and a request for viewers to reply, attend a plan meeting, and become members. The video presents participation and membership as the path associated with earning, which is more than a neutral ordinary-commerce referral.
